criteria.text: Every reservation-read callsite selects the private role-bound reader, not read_source's default sharing mode.
The actual access/share tuple is compatible with the retained writer and cannot enable foreign writes/deletes while it is held.
Identity, original bytes, owner, phase and close obligations are explicit; every operation is included in FG-C02.
All sites and call multiplicities are source-evidenced, including non-success paths and runtime boundary summaries.
Units, role/phase totals and directional counters agree with concrete operators and original S2-FD primitive-cost rules.
Complete byte/memory/protocol/cleanup derivation and independent host approval exist; inventory alone cannot pass.
Missing final runtime/authority/packet inputs leave certificate NOT_MATERIALIZED, never implicitly accepted.
Every allocating/decoding/reading path is dominated by independently rooted, already available limits.
Bounded pre-parse structure checks and complete bootstrap memory/framing costs are materializable.
Policy provenance and its finite delivery are included in FG-C04/FG-C05; missing policy blocks before payload.
Trace an independent trust anchor to each role claim, real channel and actual process identity before any side effect.
Static re-entry reasoning must show old handoff bytes and fresh ChildOwner instances cannot claim an already consumed role.
Identify concrete trusted bootstrap delivery and its source/runtime/budget evidence; a hypothetical safe transport does not pass.
Unadmitted owner transport remains a materialization blocker. No arbitrary-code-injection or compromised-OS protection is claimed.
Exact layout role and interpreter/runtime relations are validated, not merely nonempty refs.
Full bootstrap closure and protection from pre-import to completion are source-traceable and independently admitted.
Runtime, parent and durability evidence gaps remain explicit; historical observer metadata is not promoted to current recorder proof.
Every validation, setup, body, abort, cleanup and no-return branch reaches a defined external terminal assessment without promoting missing evidence.
Returned cleanup tuples and native prerequisite failures retain cause and precedence.
Success requires valid original receipts, native child exits and closures, admitted delegated operations and separate actual observer exit.
Private encoding/version adoption is explicit and closed; the unchanged current code cannot be assumed to accept these forms.

unchanged_contract.rule: Original S2-FG/S2-FH files stay byte-identical. Supplemental forms are not silently accepted by existing validators. All six code correction groups remain NOT_IMPLEMENTED; no criterion is reclassified as passed.

common_form_rules.null: Only where explicitly named; unavailable is not zero, empty string, false or a fabricated digest.
common_form_rules.encoding: Canonical JSON: sorted keys, ensure_ascii=true, separators comma/colon without whitespace, UTF-8, no floats or NaN. record_digest excludes only itself.
common_form_rules.bounds: All variable extents, counters, lists, encoding/validation and failure work use prior independently admitted FG-C02/FG-C03 limits. No executable numeric limits or new free evidence channel are created.
common_form_rules.versioning: New private v1 forms are explicit supplements, not additional fields accepted by unchanged S2-FD/S2-FG validators.
common_form_rules.authority: Serialized descriptions, digests and generation labels are not live ownership or admission.

The independent start admission binds the already computed policy digest, never the reverse; the policy does not hash its future admission, live owner or handoff.

fields.policy_digest: SHA256 or null only before policy admission

rules: One original operation per record; sequence is not a timestamp, resource identity, retry permission or success proof.
Record call entry and actual owned result at source boundary before aggregate status; no reconstruction from process exit, readable output or global success.

CONFIRMED requires RETURNED, complete package/policy/source/owner/subject bindings and operation-specific success predicate from the admitted original source. NONE is permitted only for an audited wrapper whose successful return proves this exact operation; aggregate returns do not automatically prove each nested close.

NOT_ENTERED/ENTERED/UNKNOWN or a missing required result is UNKNOWN, not a failed native call invented after the event. RAISED/observed unsuccessful return is FAILED with original cause where available.
Unknown identity and source prevent acceptance as a confirmed ClosureEvidence but do not prevent retention of this failure record.
Every acquired handle has one close attempt. Missing observation after an attempt cannot trigger another close.

fields.volume: Exactly {filesystem: literal NTFS, serial_hex: 16 lowercase hex characters}

rules: Identical native identity shape to WindowsFiles.inspect after removing the kind discriminator. Path role is checked separately against admitted inventory; retain actual handle continuity through operation. No reopen after close to invent earlier identity.
From actual retained process handle; a PID alone or serialized handle value is insufficient.
Actual retained local endpoint and native parent/child observations back this tuple; only equality of serialized descriptions is insufficient.

fields.operation_evidence: Bounded list of OriginalOperationEvidence in fixed FG-role order then strictly increasing sequence; no duplicates

rules: Existing ClosureEvidence.operation_receipt_digest references exactly an included canonical original operation record. Each reference resolves uniquely.

All records belong to the same attempt and, when known, package/policy/owner chain. Unreferenced failures must still be retained with their missing evidence; unrelated successes or foreign records reject the bundle.
Closure CONFIRMED requires identical resource role/kind, actual owner identity, subject identity, source FileRef and qualified operation, plus original CONFIRMED result.
For DIRECT_OS, reporter is the actual native owner. Receiving that owner's bytes is DELEGATED_SOURCE_BOUND at the receiver and additionally requires the admitted live route and source order.
Original receipt FileRefs in TerminalEvidence remain real file references; inline operation records are not relabeled as files.
Bundle is carried on existing bounded private terminal channels; no new file, marker, recorder role or recursive self-recording.

rules: This is the explicit external no-return/identity-unavailable fallback, not a nullable reinterpretation of CallerCompletionEvidence.
NOT_ATTEMPTED requires actual no-spawn knowledge; FAILED_NO_CHILD requires a definitively failed creation with no child. Ambiguous creation is UNKNOWN even with no returned handle.

NOT_APPLICABLE requires definitely no child and all identity parts null. UNAVAILABLE means no identity parts known for CREATED/UNKNOWN; PARTIAL means at least one but fewer than all three genuinely observed parts.

Known parts must come from the same retained observer handle and original acquisition sequence. Never combine child claims, command-line PID, earlier attempts or a configured expected interpreter with native observations.

If all three parts are known, use unchanged CallerCompletionEvidence and ordinary terminal failures, not this fallback. A known but mismatching full identity is a binding failure, not a missing identity.
Handle acquisition creates cleanup responsibility before identity succeeds. Unknown identity never excuses required bounded cleanup or creates authority to close a serialized foreign handle.
No child means EOF/close may be UNKNOWN as not applicable, explicitly listed; never claim a successful close of a handle that never existed.
Failure to receive/validate even this bounded record remains external no-return UNKNOWN and rejects completion; no invented replacement, truncation or retry.
No audit or later constructed identity may promote a finalized fallback to successful completion.

fields.evidence: Unchanged S2-FG CallerCompletionEvidence for COMPLETE_IDENTITY; CallerIdentityFailureEvidence for IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE

rules: Exactly one branch; no implicit conversion. COMPLETE_IDENTITY does not mean success: all unchanged FG final acceptance conditions still apply. IDENTITY_UNAVAILABLE is always rejecting.

trust_root: The independent caller is the explicit trust root already required by S2-FD/FG, not another recursively self-certified observer.

Before observer invocation, the caller owns independently admitted source/runtime closure, original execution/review/admission bytes, complete budget and BootstrapPolicy. Prior independently admitted schema bounds bound creation/delivery of that policy itself.
The caller must provide a live launch context before any payload input, not obtain authority from JSON, CLI, environment, a new ContextVar, START/OWNED, supplied PID/handle or old dispatch/seal.

Only the existing parent-owned stdin/stdout process channels may carry bounded control/handoff data. Child bootstrap must already possess an independently admitted expectation for the actual parent and retained endpoint plus finite parser bounds; a policy arriving as the first message cannot establish those prerequisites.

The existing code does not yet provide that pre-input child expectation or its independently rooted delivery. This document selects no new service, file role, privileged launcher or cryptographic scheme and does not claim that the missing mechanism exists.
Missing pre-input expectation rejects before reading even the eight-byte header. Hash equality and expected parent PID/image reported by that same pipe do not close the missing-root condition.
handoff_sequence: Caller independently admits package, policy, source closure and current observer ownership; absence blocks before side effects.
Observer retains the only shared role-claim state for starter/supervisor/worker. Caller retains one-use ownership of the observer invocation; neither can be reconstructed from records.

Before each existing parent Popen, parent requests the exact role through the live admitted chain. Request is evaluated against that parent's independently expected identity and package/policy/attempt, not its supplied assertions.

Observer atomically changes that role UNUSED -> CLAIMED before authorizing the sole parent spawn. Parallel/replayed claims reject. Failed/ambiguous delivery or spawn consumes the attempt; no rollback.

Parent retains actual newly acquired handle before identity checks. Observer adopts and checks actual child identity and retained channel mapping. A lost/failed adoption is terminal FAILED/UNKNOWN with cleanup, never a grant retry.

Only after adoption can the descriptive LiveOwnerHandoff bind SPAWNED plus complete identities and channels. Independently admitted child bootstrap compares it to its already installed live expectations.

Policy is available before encoding/allocation/header reading; all later package, wire originals and process limits must exactly match. All control/claim/ack and evidence bytes count in the same original counters/deadlines.
Worker release additionally requires supervisor RESERVED and FG-C01 verification of the actual retained reservation. Existing dispatch/seal remain consumption evidence only.
SPAWNED -> TERMINAL or FAILED/UNKNOWN. CLAIMED with failed/ambiguous spawn also ends FAILED/UNKNOWN. Lost owner never authorizes reconstruction, new ChildOwner role budget, respawn or a new attempt.

originality: Capture actual operation entry/result under the resource owner, with original callsite, phase, sequence, subject and original native failure code if known.
Store original canonical operation bytes in bounded private memory; receiver verifies unchanged bytes and their digest plus current live route. No new output or ledger files.

An existing original recorder/control entry can back the receipt only where it actually records the required operation/result and validated subject. Preserve its original file evidence; do not claim an omitted operation was present.
Close/flush provenance must identify the real retained handle generation and pre-close native identity. Later readability, another file open, exit code or success Boolean cannot substitute.

Source-bound wrapper confirmation is admissible only after static proof that its exact normal return implies all required native operations and no swallowed error. A aggregate publish/finish return without that operation-level link is insufficient.

ControlTrace.finish -> _ControlSpool.finish -> flush/verify/close order exists. Its own close is intentionally absent from the recursive control transcript. Its source-bound outcome must therefore be retained separately by the owning private call boundary and sent on the existing terminal channel after return.

If unchanged existing code hides individual close outcomes or cleanup errors so that private boundaries cannot supply original evidence, outcome is UNKNOWN and FG-C06 stays blocked. This contract does not authorize modifying the eight existing modules or treating a new digest as original evidence.
Record every primary/cleanup error separately; never discard abort() results. Missing evidence cannot be repaired by a second operation.
acceptance_order: Prior finite bounds and expected live channel ownership.
Closed shapes, canonical original bytes and self-digests.
Same attempt/package/policy and actual owner/source/phase/resource bindings.
Exact operation success predicate, original native result and unique sequence/handle generation.
Exact one-to-one closure reference resolution and resource-kind/subject compatibility.
Original terminal files, native exits, remaining FG terminal rules and unchanged status precedence.
Independent later caller assessment, never retroactively included in operation or terminal digests.

branch_rules: Preserve the complete, nonnullable FG CallerCompletionEvidence.observer_identity unchanged. CallerAssessment selects a separate failure form only when full observer identity is unavailable.

Never derive CreationIdentity from partial values, configured path, reported PID, old attempt, zeros or a hash. Preserve actual partial observations, their failed acquisition operation and cleanup evidence.

An acquired handle remains owned even if identity acquisition fails. Existing one-close-attempt and bounded termination/wait rules remain applicable, without repeating identity acquisition to retry completion.
Before definitely any child or side effect, absent prerequisite uses BLOCKED_PREREQUISITE unless a higher FG status applies. Unknown not-yet-required EOF/close is not an actual failed close.

After attempted/ambiguous creation, missing required observer identity/exit/owned closure prevents terminal confirmation and uses COMPLETION_UNCONFIRMED when rank 1 applies. Unknown consumption also denies retry; rank 1 remains above ALREADY_CONSUMED.
Known full but wrong identity remains a binding failure through existing failure rules; it cannot be disguised as missing identity or accepted full completion.
Failure of the caller's own bounded assessment channel is an external missing result, not a new recursively observing process or synthetic success file.

Success still requires original successful TerminalEvidence plus unchanged valid CallerCompletionEvidence, actual observer exit zero, actual EOF and confirmed owned-handle close. The failure branch cannot satisfy it.

digest_dependencies: Admitted source/runtime/layout/parent facts and independently bounded schema/host assumptions.
Complete justified budget, package and BootstrapPolicy; actual encoding must fit prior bounds.
Independent start admission binds preceding policy and package. No backward dependency on owner, child or result.
Live owner/role claim, then actual adopted child/channel identities and LiveOwnerHandoff.
Owned original operation records, then ClosureEvidence, then TerminalEvidence and PrivateTerminalBundle.
Independent caller's actual later observation and CallerAssessment; earlier records cannot hash this later result.
